slides.title: Why Americans can't buy this Jimny until 2043.
slides.body: Suzuki never certified the JB74 for the US. The 25-year import rule counts from the build date, and production began on 29 May 2018.

slides.credit: Jimny JB74 · Jakub Hałun · CC BY-SA 4.0
slides.title: CBP seized one in 2022.
slides.body: A 2022 Jimny bought in Mexico and taken to Puerto Rico. DOT ruled it under 25 years old: bring it into compliance, export it or destroy it.

slides.eyebrow: So in the US it's the Samurai
slides.title: Lighter, shorter, lower geared.
slides.body: About 2,100 lb on a 79.9 in wheelbase, a 43° approach angle and a 2.268 low range. The JB74 is ~300 lb heavier with a taller 2.002 low.

slides.title: $8k–17k for a driver.
slides.body: Projects $5k–9k, the best $20k–25k. Both trucks share a 5 x 5.5 in bolt pattern and take a 215/75R15 with no lift.

end.title: Samurai now, or wait for 2043?
end.body: The full comparison: specs, what breaks, prices and the import rules.
